game_start.intro: Inmasmeh so juego. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump card: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} diad German Whist.
{phase_info}
Holdan mo {hand_size} kardas.
Playa so karda na '[play N]', no diad position to diad kamot mo (for example '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: PANAGKAALAM: Say analo ed kada triko so mangala na akaarap a kard tan say atalo et mangitonton na onsublay ya kard manlapud deck. Saray triko a nalmoan diad sayan yugto so ag-ibilang parad panatalo.
player_prompt.phase_playing: MANGAGALAN NA PASE: say deck et naupot la. Manlapud natan, amin a pakana so makatulong pian manalo itayo.

next_card.playing_phase: Anggapo so card ya iiter - ginmapo la so panggalaw.
next_card.deck_empty: Anggapoy karga na deck - anggapo so card ya isasaliw.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mali so format na galaw. Usaren '[play N]' pian galawen so Nth karta ed sika'y lima.
invalid_move.bad_position: Ag-itan nagagawa. Kawalaan na {hand_size} a kard mo.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Nepeg mon tumboken so alimbawa ra tan i-play moy {lead_suit} a kard.

game_action.played: Say manggagalaw a {player_id} so nilugal na {card}.

trick.won: Say manlalaban a {winner_id} so analo ed trick ya walay {card}.
trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} so napanalo ed trick na {card} tan agala ed karta na nengneng ed bokig.

phase.learning_complete: Asumpal lay panaon na panaral - amin a nakekeraan ya galaw so makanepegan parad pananalo.

draw.winner_received: Manalo ka ed trick tan akaawat kay {card}.
draw.loser_received: Naandi so triko tan inala toy {card} manlapud deck.
draw.winner_preview: Say ontumbok a card ya isasaliw et {card}.

turn.phase_learning: Phase: {phase} ({remaining_cards} kardas a nasisilbi diad deck)

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Anggapoy karga na saray kard ed lima to.

trick_view.empty: Anggapo ni aka-play na saray kard ed sayan trick.

board_str.next_card:
{observation}
Sikato a karda para ken winner: {card}
board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Player {player_id}: {scoring} scoring tricks ({tricks} anggad), {hand_size} kardas diad kamot

outcome.summary: Paseg ya anapan - Aguman 0: {l0}, Aguman 1: {l1}. Paseg ya palaro - Aguman 0: {p0}, Aguman 1: {p1}. Say Aguman {winner_id} so nangabak ed {winner_tricks} pakamalan ya manalo!
